description: This file defines an abstract generic class 'GeneralizedReferenceTypeSurrogateCodec' implementing serialization logic for reference types using surrogates, including reading and writing methods, and conversion between the type and its surrogate.

classes.name: GeneralizedReferenceTypeSurrogateCodec
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a surrogate serializer for reference types and their surrogate representations, providing methods for reading, writing, and converting between types.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a value of type TField from a reader, handling reference tracking and surrogate conversion.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes a value of type TField to a writer, converting to surrogate and handling reference serialization.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Abstract method to convert from surrogate type TSurrogate to TField.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Abstract method to convert from TField to surrogate type TSurrogate.
